ety.text: Usually explained as an early Turkic borrowing (< Proto-Turkic *köbüŕ). Compare Slovak and Czech koberec, Polish kobierzec, archaic Bulgarian губер (guber). Mikkola, quoted by Vasmer and Karl Brugmann, derives the Russian word from Old Norse kǫgurr (“quilt”). This derivation is difficult for phonetic and semantic reasons and fails to explain the Czech and Bulgarian cognates. Unrelated to English cover or French couvert.
